description: This file contains internal functions for converting runtime/metrics descriptions into Prometheus metric names, validating them, and processing histogram buckets for specific units. It is part of the Prometheus client library's internal metrics handling.

methods.name: RuntimeMetricsToProm
methods.description: Converts a runtime/metrics description into a Prometheus-compatible metric name, subsystem, and unit, and validates the name.

methods.name: RuntimeMetricsBucketsForUnit
methods.description: Adjusts histogram buckets based on the unit, re-bucketing for bytes and seconds.

methods.name: reBucketExp
methods.description: Reduces the number of buckets by grouping them exponentially based on a base, handling -Inf buckets appropriately.
